questions.prompt: In PTC mode, the model calls read directly instead of through run_code. What happens?
options: The call fails, with a message to call read from inside a run_code program
The harness wraps it in a program automatically
The session switches back to normal mode
questions.explanation: Only run_code is callable directly. Other tools are reachable only from inside a program.

questions.prompt: Why does the history stay small when a program reads 40 files?
options: The program deletes the files after reading
The files are compressed before they reach the model
Only the value the program returns or prints becomes the tool result
The model reads the files from its memory
questions.explanation: The file texts stay inside the program. The model gets only the returned value, here about 10 tokens.

questions.prompt: In the trace, how many model steps does counting lines in 40 files take with a program?
questions.explanation: Step 1 sends the program and step 2 answers from its result. All 41 tool calls happen inside the program.
